text:
eva: FYI ran a focused KV quant bench overnight across fp8-kv and int8-kv on redwood-small-7b. Dataset: eval-1M-seqs (mixed chat+qa). Baseline is fp16-kv.

carlos: High-level summary: int8-kv -> ~30-34% KV memory savings, mean token latency +1.2ms. fp8-kv -> ~46-49% KV memory savings, but cold-start 95p tail increases by ~5-8ms and we saw rewarm spikes on some traces.

bench-bot: Automated upload: perf csv + flamegraphs -> https://internal/reports/1802500000 (artifact bundle).

alex: Accuracy check: token-level top-1 acc delta: int8 ~-0.1% relative, fp8 ~-0.5% relative. Downstream QA eval: fp8 had ~0.8% F1 drop on long-context examples (>=4k). Short-context is fine.

maria: carlos, can you paste the exact runner config for fp8 so ops can repro?

carlos: config used: 
```
model_config:
  kv_quant: fp8-kv
  kv_block_size: 512
  kv_cache_policy: eager_rewarm
  quant_calib: per-channel
```
(repro notebook in artifact).

eva: Note: eager_rewarm caused the biggest tail spikes. Switching to lazy_rewarm lowers 95p but increases jitter for first few tokens (tradeoff).

bijal: Rollout proposal: enable int8-kv as default on Dedicated (immediate cost win). Gate fp8-kv behind a feature flag + 2-week canary on low-traffic internal chat routes, with automatic rollback on quality-regression >1% or latency SLO breach >10%.

alex: Observed failure mode for fp8: tokenization boundary drift in some code-gen loops after very long prefixes (repro snippet saved). Looks like quant noise accumulates for some attention patterns.

carlos: Specific failure: repeated sentinel token drift after prefixes >8k tokens for per-tensor quant. Per-channel quant mostly fixes it, but per-channel slightly reduces compression ratio. Also block size interacts: smaller blocks reduce drift but cost more memory.

bench-bot: Perf numbers (mean tokens/sec, same load profile): baseline fp16-kv 1200 tps, int8-kv 1380 tps (+15%), fp8-kv 1560 tps (+30%). Cold-start 95p tail: fp16 38ms, int8 42ms, fp8 50ms (observed on p4d-like instance profiles).

maria: Please attach GPU memory + host heap flamegraphs; want KV vs model param breakdown for the int8 vs fp8 runs.

carlos: Uploaded: https://internal/storage/kv_quant_bench/1802500000 (flamegraphs + small notebook that reproduces the drift).

eva: Next steps: (1) Ship int8-kv to Dedicated with runbook + rollout checklist, (2) schedule fp8-kv calibration sweep (per-channel + block-size grid) to find stable config, (3) add KV warmup profiling and a console metric for rewarm spikes.

bijal: I'll draft the canary playbook and add detection rules in Console for sudden QA delta or increased 95p tail. Will include mitigation steps (rollback, switch kv_cache_policy to lazy_rewarm, force cold-warm cache priming). :+1:

alex: If nobody objects I'll open the MR to make int8-kv the new default for Dedicated and add a feature flag for fp8-kv. :shipit:

eva: No objections from me. Thanks for the thorough bench and artifacts.

carlos: One more note: calibration stats (per-channel) are in the notebook; some layers prefer channel-wise scaling to avoid outlier amplification. We'll iterate.

bench-bot: Summary artifact checksum: sha256:fa3b2c9... (see bundle).

maria: Great work. I'll queue the calibration sweep in the next ML infra window and link results here.

eva: Closing loop — we'll sync in tomorrow's ML stand to confirm rollout timeline.
